expression:
local({
  fnm <- as.numeric(E_LT_FNM)
  fa <- as.numeric(E_FM_F_1) == 1 &
    case_when(YEAR == 2008 ~ fnm %in% c(1, 2), YEAR == 2025 ~ TRUE, .default = as.numeric(E_LT_F) == 1)
  sf <- as.numeric(E_FM_SF_2) == 2 &
    case_when(YEAR == 2008 ~ fnm %in% c(1, 2), YEAR == 2025 ~ TRUE, .default = as.numeric(E_LT_SF) == 1)
  mo <- as.numeric(E_FM_M_3) == 3 &
    case_when(YEAR == 2008 ~ fnm %in% c(1, 3), YEAR == 2025 ~ TRUE, .default = as.numeric(E_LT_M) == 1)
  sm <- as.numeric(E_FM_SM_4) == 4 &
    case_when(YEAR == 2008 ~ fnm %in% c(1, 3), YEAR == 2025 ~ TRUE, .default = as.numeric(E_LT_SM) == 1)
  case_when(
    as.numeric(E_FM_F_1) == 8888 ~ "Unknown",
    fa & mo ~ "Two biological/adoptive parents",
    (sf | sm) & (fa | mo) ~ "Step family",
    fa | mo ~ "Single parent",
    !is.na(fa) & !is.na(mo) ~ "Other",
    .default = "Unknown"
  )
})
notes: Roster ticks (father, stepfather, mother, stepmother) count only co-resident figures (co-residence items 2008-2024; the 2025 roster lists co-resident family only); two resident parents = Two biological/adoptive parents whatever the step ticks, no resident parent = Other, 8888 (block skipped, 2019-2025) = Unknown. notes: Every wave (2008-2025). Student self-report: usual weekday bedtime and wake time, past 7 days (24-hour clock); hours = wake - bed, wrapped past midnight. Partial: bed and wake times, not hours asleep. The study sets bedtimes 04:00-20:00 and wake times outside 04:00-09:00 to missing. The 2005-2009 banded weekday sleep-hours item (M_SLP_DR) is not used.

expression: ((as.numeric(M_WK_HR_K) + as.numeric(M_WK_MM_K) / 60) - (as.numeric(M_SLP_HR_K) + as.numeric(M_SLP_MM_K) / 60)) %% 24
notes: 2013-2025 only. Student self-report: usual weekend bedtime and wake time, past 7 days; as hlth_sleep_wd, but the study applies no outlier cleaning to weekend times. Partial: bed and wake times, not hours asleep.

source_columns: M_SLP_HR, M_SLP_MM, M_WK_HR, M_WK_MM, M_SLP_HR_K, M_SLP_MM_K, M_WK_HR_K, M_WK_MM_K
expression:
(5 *
  (((as.numeric(M_WK_HR) + as.numeric(M_WK_MM) / 60) - (as.numeric(M_SLP_HR) + as.numeric(M_SLP_MM) / 60)) %% 24) +
  2 *
    (((as.numeric(M_WK_HR_K) + as.numeric(M_WK_MM_K) / 60) - (as.numeric(M_SLP_HR_K) + as.numeric(M_SLP_MM_K) / 60)) %%
      24)) /
  7
notes: 2013-2025 only. Student self-report: (5 x hlth_sleep_wd + 2 x hlth_sleep_we) / 7; partial as bed and wake times.
Single item only (sleep enough to recover from fatigue, past 7 days); no sleep-problems scale; mapped nowhere.
